headline: On November 3, 2016: Chicago Cubs win World Series
instagramCaption:
Chicago Cubs end a 108-year title drought. \\[The Chicago Cubs beat the Cleveland Indians in the 2016 World Series, winning their first championship since 1908. The Cubs, an American professional baseball team, play their home games at Wrigley Field, a National Historic Landmark. This victory was a historic moment for the team and its fans, who had waited over a century for this triumph.\\Why does it still matter today?
